COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 22, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:30 PM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner
Sophea Chim, Commissioner

  COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS IN-PERSON MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 979 8822 6890
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/97988226890

  PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56775  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meetings of Wednesday, August 27, 2025 and Saturday, September 27, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56776  Recommendation to receive and file a Know Your Rights training from ORALE
  (Organizing Rooted in Abolition, Liberation, and Empowerment).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56777  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from 4GIRLS highlighting its
  mission-driven initiatives to cultivate self-confidence, leadership, and
  empowerment among young women in Long Beach.

  Page 1 of 2
   COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 22, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56778  Recommendation to appoint two delegates to represent the Long Beach
  Commission for Women and Girls at the California Convening of Commissions and
  Anniversary Celebration, co-hosted by the Los Angeles County Commission for
  Women and the California Commission on the Status of Women and Girls, on
  Monday, November 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56779  Recommendation to receive and file the Commission for Women and Girls
  Quarterly Budget Report for the period of July through September 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-56780  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact he Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
